description: "Gets the object from the object store. For a cron expression, the object is the command, and the entry is /etc/cron.d/backup for backup, mode 0644: one line of the cron expression, the user (root when none is given) and the command. For a daily interval, the object is the script, written as /etc/cron.daily/backup, mode 0755, which runs as root, so a user is refused. An object of content type template, or content_type template, is rendered with the agent's facts and the vars. A file that has the content does not change. An entry of the name in a different directory does not change: move it with delete and create. A file at the path that osapi did not deploy is refused. An entry runs as its user, root included, so only admin can deploy one."

Gets the object from the object store. For a cron expression, the object is the command, and the entry is /etc/cron.d/backup for backup, mode 0644: one line of the cron expression, the user (root when none is given) and the command. For a daily interval, the object is the script, written as /etc/cron.daily/backup, mode 0755, which runs as root, so a user is refused. An object of content type template, or content_type template, is rendered with the agent's facts and the vars. A file that has the content does not change. An entry of the name in a different directory does not change: move it with delete and create. A file at the path that osapi did not deploy is refused. An entry runs as its user, root included, so only admin can deploy one.
